note.message: mamelet on web could not read its record of the checks of its writes, and set it aside (linux-checks.json.corrupt in its state directory): whether the check of a write of /etc/nginx/conf.d/site.conf was left unfinished, and the file not put back, is not known
note.hint: run the check on the node by hand (nginx -t) and put back what it does not accept; then remove the file set aside from mamelet's state directory, and plan again
